summary: Fresh current-source baseline and hostile-ecology feature workloads match in world, profile, semantic action chain, and six one-minute wait windows; only the intended ecology fixture/variant differs. Measurements are finite and descriptive. OCR and historical replay were excluded, and broker lifecycle evidence remains bounded to retained writer identities and current OS absence.
first_open_boundary: Subjective feel, broader repeated-run statistics, and durable broker graceful-exit verification remain unproved.
outcome: Fresh source-current baseline and hostile-ecology feature workloads are equivalently constructed and have matching native workload boundaries. Mechanical measurements are finite and descriptive; they do not establish subjective feel or a performance regression verdict.

acknowledgment.ocr_non_proof: Applied: OCR, screenshots, terminal bytes, and rendered text were not used to establish input, elapsed time, gameplay state, or proof.
acknowledgment.no_replay: Applied: no historical R-028 run was replayed or substituted; only fresh current-source continuation runs were used.
acknowledgment.lifecycle: Applied: game PID birth identities and native save/quit receipts were retained, with current OS absence checked. No durable broker PID/birth/exit artifact exists; broker lifecycle evidence is limited to current absence plus run-local writer identities.

measurements.interpretation: Descriptive CPU/RSS and raw renderer pacing only; no synthetic scorer or automatic time/RSS termination.

evidence_ceiling: Mechanical/setup evidence only; no subjective visual smoothness or gameplay-feel claim.
Broker graceful exit independently unproven as stated above.
source_changes: None; this closure receipt records and bounds existing evidence only.
